Name: Sally's Spa

Type: KMP

House Fee: $80

Location: 34th Street between Broadway and 5th Street, Manhattan, NY

There is something I really enjoy more about KMPs than AMPs and why it's worth a couple extra dollars for me. KMPs tend to be more client centric, take more ownership of the session and are somewhat more playful and sensual. Sally's is no different.

Located in the heart of touristy Manhattan, Sally's gives it's clients a break from the hustle and bustle in a true KMP experience. The location of Sally's is no secret, you'll see a sign on 34th right by the Empire State Building. It's a four floor walk up but you'll have to be buzzed in, so likely you'll need an appointment in advance.

Upon entering you'll be greeted by the manager who will greet you with your provider. As far as the girls, they are all attractive, but some may vary in age. I've never been put off by the appearance of any of the girls. You'll get undressed and your provider will bring you to the table shower. I will say compared to Silk Tigers, the TS will be shorter and less playful. It shouldn't be a deal breaker though.

After the table shower, your provider will bring you to a private room. Sally's is a bit larger than other spas, so there's an interesting communication system that girls have when entering the hallway with a patron, likely to minimize the risk you bump into a fellow monger (imagine running into your boss during your lunch break?).

The provider will ask for the house fee and return. You may tip up front if that's your style, the regular city KMP rates apply here. Exceptional service should be a tip of $140.

The massage here is pretty weak. Don't expect anything great, maybe a rundown at best. She'll ask you whether you want hard, soft, etc., but I usually don't bother.

After about 20-25 min, she'll ask you to turn over and she'll leave the room likely to tell the manager and to get some tools of the trade. The ST will be highly sensual and she'll use more than just her hands which is common to KMPs. There will be a strong buildup to whatever end you bargained for.

One thing about Sally's (and likely other KMPs) is the work hours. Girls work 10am-3am and get one week off a month. I've never heard a girl complain, but that's the life of a provider.

Sallys, like Silk Tigers, is a good place after you've gotten down the AMP experience. It's location is very convenient and the quality of service is very good.
Review: Sally's Spa, KMP, Manhattan, NY
